# Statistical Modeling and Machine Learning

Student presentations in this chapter concern statistical reasoning,
prediction, dimension reduction, clustering, and supervised learning.

**Topic presentation:**
[Multidimensional Scaling](../topic/hartman-mds/) by Mikaela Hartman

This presentation introduces multidimensional scaling, a tool for modeling
high-dimensional pairwise data in a low-dimensional space. It includes one
low-dimensional and one high-dimensional example of metric multidimensional
scaling and discusses limitations of the method.
